title: Convert the accepted cross-request caching design (#11633) into an ADR — governed surface: draft PR, human merge
body:
Follow-up ruled in #11633's acceptance (§9 of the design, proposal accepted). Provenance: design document = #11633 comment 5394942824; maintainer acceptance = #11633 comment 5404681591 (2026-08-25, verbatim 「接受你的建议，继续」). Filed by PM session `session_01KWRU3s15AJz7PGW7a7wdCh`.

Blocked-by: #10348

(The design named two unlanded premises: #10348-C and the #11663 ruling. The #11663 condition is **met** — ruled 2026-08-25, #11663 comment 5404675670. #10348-C remains the only gate.)

**Content**: convert the accepted design comment into an ADR recording the durable rule — *no authorization answer is cached without a declared invalidation contract and a TTL bound* — plus the staleness posture (leg B off by default, TTL=0, supported low-seconds range), the fork rulings (coarse invalidation; TTL + `authz.invalidated` with TTL as the contract; session-of-record stays uncached per #4785), and the expiry-boundary rule (`min(ttl, nextBoundary)` — validity windows see no write at their boundary).

**Governed surface discipline**: `docs/adr/**` — draft PR only, request review from the maintainer; ⛔ never flipped ready, never queued, never auto-merged by a seat; human merge is the review record.

**Acceptance criterion**: a draft PR exists converting comment 5394942824 into `docs/adr/**`, its body linking both rulings (#11633 comment 5404681591, #11663 comment 5404675670), left for the maintainer.
